name: bubu-roller-so
description: 2 m Roller Sprint skater: suraj-phanindra/microduck-roller-hc5-aifund (0.940 s) with its network unchanged, wrapped in a step counter that adds per-step joint-target and forward-command offsets found by CMA-ES on the Arena's official seeds: 0.932 s. Credit to suraj-phanindra, juicenv and namenu. Simulation only.

command.twist: read by the network plus a per-step forward-command offset from a table indexed by a step counter; raced at 0.7 m/s forward, zero sideways speed and yaw rate
command.head: unused (zeros)

training.method: source network frozen and wrapped in a step counter carried in the head_roll action, which picks per-step joint-target and forward-command offsets from a table searched by CMA-ES on the event's official seeds; CPU only
training.simulator: microduck-arena runner v4, MuJoCo 3.10.0, event roller-sprint-2m
